title: Two codes, one description
hook: Two part codes, both noted as 'grey cable'. Which one will you remember?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that two near-identical items get mixed up unless the note records the one detail that tells them apart

misconception: Two very similar items can be learned from the same description.
objective: Check the specific difference between two arbitrary codes.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Two part codes, both noted as 'grey cable'. Which one will you remember? Codes K-417 and K-471, both noted as 'grey cable'. Asked for the grey cable's code, how often do you pick the right one? Options: Always: I learned it / About half the time. Correct option: About half the time. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: K-417 and K-471 share the note 'grey cable', so that cue fits both and a pick is a guess. Adding what differs, here the length, makes the cue fit one code.
